name: MonarchScreenShareView
title: ScreenShareView
wrapsNative: ScrollView with MagnifyGesture around a video slot; accessibilityZoomAction
summary: Shows a screen that someone shares in a call: who is presenting, the picture with zoom and pan, and controls for zoom, picture in picture, full screen and stop sharing.
whenToUse: In a call, to view a shared screen whose video view comes from the product's call SDK.
whenNotToUse: Not for capturing a screen, which stays in the product (ReplayKit). For ordinary video playback use VideoPlayer.
api: init(_ presenterName: String, isLocal: Bool = false, isWaiting: Bool = false, isPictureInPictureActive: Bool = false, isFullScreen: Bool = false, labels: MonarchScreenShareViewLabels = MonarchScreenShareViewLabels(), showsControls: Bool = true, onPictureInPicture: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onFullScreen: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onStopSharing: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder video: () -> Video)

init(_ presenterName: String, zoom: Binding<Double>, isLocal: Bool = false, isWaiting: Bool = false, isPictureInPictureActive: Bool = false, isFullScreen: Bool = false, labels: MonarchScreenShareViewLabels = MonarchScreenShareViewLabels(), showsControls: Bool = true, onPictureInPicture: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onFullScreen: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onStopSharing: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder video: () -> Video)

struct MonarchScreenShareViewLabels { init(presenting: String? = nil, youArePresenting: String? = nil, region: String? = nil, controls: String? = nil, waiting: String? = nil, localPreviewHidden: String? = nil, showPreview: String? = nil, fit: String? = nil, zoomIn: String? = nil, zoomOut: String? = nil, pictureInPicture: String? = nil, exitPictureInPicture: String? = nil, fullScreen: String? = nil, exitFullScreen: String? = nil, stopSharing: String? = nil) }

options.name: presenterName
options.description: Who is sharing, as it should be read.

options.name: zoom
options.description: The zoom factor, 1 (fit) to 3. Second initialiser; the first keeps the zoom itself.

options.name: isLocal
options.description: The person using the app is sharing: the picture is hidden until asked for, and Stop sharing can be offered.

options.name: isWaiting
options.description: The shared screen has not arrived: a waiting text replaces the picture.

options.name: isPictureInPictureActive
options.description: Switches the picture-in-picture button to its exit form.

options.name: isFullScreen
options.description: Switches the full-screen button to its exit form.

options.name: showsControls
options.description: Shows the zoom, picture-in-picture and full-screen controls.

options.name: onPictureInPicture
options.description: Starts or ends picture in picture. Adds the button.

options.name: onFullScreen
options.description: Enters or leaves full screen. Adds the button.

options.name: onStopSharing
options.description: Stops sharing. Adds the button when isLocal.

options.name: video
options.description: The picture, from the product's call SDK.

states.name: fit
states.description: The whole picture fits a 16 by 9 area; Zoom out and Fit are disabled.

states.name: zoomed
states.description: The picture is larger than the area and pans by dragging; the level is shown as a percentage.

states.name: waiting
states.description: "Waiting for the shared screen…" on the muted background.

states.name: local, preview hidden
states.description: A notice with a "Show preview" button replaces the picture.

states.name: picture in picture active
states.description: The button shows the exit symbol, is named "Exit picture in picture" and has the selected trait.

appearance: The picture sits on the inverse background colour with 12-point corners; the waiting text and the notice sit on the muted background. Controls are ghost buttons; Stop sharing is a danger button.
platformNotes: The web takes a MediaStream and starts browser picture in picture and full screen itself. On iOS the picture is a slot for the call SDK's view, and picture in picture (AVPictureInPictureController needs the video layer) and full screen (a presentation) are started by the product through onPictureInPicture and onFullScreen; the view only shows the buttons and their state. Zoom adds pinch and double tap to the web's buttons, and steps through the same levels: 100%, 150%, 200%, 300%. The web keyboard shortcuts (+, -, 0) are not offered.
accessibility: The picture is one element named "Screen shared by …" with the image trait and the zoom level as its value.
The picture responds to the VoiceOver zoom gesture and to swipe up and down, which step through the zoom levels.
The controls are a group named "Shared screen controls"; icon buttons have spoken names and 44-point touch targets.
A zoom level chosen with a button is announced.
The picture-in-picture button has the selected trait while active.
The content of the shared screen is not described.
edgeCases: Pinching does not keep the point under the fingers in place; the scroll position is kept.
A zoom binding outside 1 to 3 is clamped.
When the controls do not fit one row they wrap to two, below the presenter line.
With isLocal and isWaiting the notice has no "Show preview" button.
VoiceOver cannot pan the zoomed picture.

examples.title: Someone else presenting
examples.template:
MonarchScreenShareView(
    {{presenter}},
    zoom: $zoom,
    onPictureInPicture: {},
    onFullScreen: {},
    video: {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space4) {
            Text({{slide.title}})
                .monarchTextStyle(.title)
            Text("\u{2022} {{slide.bullets.0|raw}}")
            Text("\u{2022} {{slide.bullets.1|raw}}")
            Text("\u{2022} {{slide.bullets.2|raw}}")
        }
        .monarchTextStyle(.body)
        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textDefault)
        .padding(theme.spacing.space4)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
        .background(theme.colors.bgSurface)
    }
)
examples.setupTemplate:
@Environment(\.monarchTheme) private var theme
@State private var zoom = 1.0
examples.setup:
@Environment(\.monarchTheme) private var theme
@State private var zoom = 1.0
